description: COMMEDI 2012 - Gares à proximité des zones d'activités économiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France. Punctual representation of railway stations located nearby and serving the economic activity areas of the Nord - Pas de Calais region. GEMET - INSPIRE themes, version 1.0: Transport networks. Coverage: Géo2France. The portal shows the English title as "COMMEDI 2012 - Stations near economic activity areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France. Its keywords include zones-dactivites-economiques, commedi, reseaux-de-transport, 2012, gares-ferroviaires, reseau-ferre. The listing shows 3 download or service links in OGC:WFS, OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
